ValidationRule.description: Voice Call SID from Twilio must start with 'CF' or 'CA' and should have 34 characters in total
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Call_Log', NOT(LEN(Voice_Call_SID__c) = 34), NOT( OR( BEGINS(Voice_Call_SID__c, 'CF'), BEGINS(Voice_Call_SID__c, 'CA') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Voice Call SID must start with 'CF' or 'CA' and should have 34 characters in total
